name: multi-agents
description: Hand a coding task to a team of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) in isolated git worktrees and review the patch they return.

interface.shortDescription: Hand a task to a team of coding agents and review the patch
interface.longDescription: Run Claude Code and Codex as a team in isolated git worktrees: a coder and a reviewer, or several workers and a judge. You get one patch and an itemized cost record, and nothing changes in your tree until you approve it.
defaultPrompt: Use multi-agents to get a second opinion on this failing test.
